Thanks for sending this over, Erin — I got the PDF and looped in our billing lead (Monica) and tax compliance (Lauren) to validate. A few quick items so we can process and clear INV-78921: 

- Format: We accept a single blanket affidavit as long as it explicitly lists the states/counties where you claim resale and includes your company sales tax or reseller ID.
- Missouri nuance: Some MO counties (including St. Louis and Jefferson) expect either a county permit number or a notarized affidavit. Its not universal, but if your form is notarized we can fast-track verification.
- Required fields we check: company legal name, mailing address, reseller/sales tax ID, effective date, expiration (or "blanket" term), signature and printed name.

Preferred submission: secure upload to our portal (link below). If you prefer DocuSign, that works too — we just need a signed PDF.

Secure upload: https://redwood.app/secure-upload/MWI-78921
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

I attached a short checklist for submissions.

Next steps from our side: Monica will do a quick validation and let you know if additional county-specific stamping/notarization is required. If its needed, well keep the invoice on hold until the stamped copy arrives.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
viv...@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_submission_instructions.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Erin —

Thanks — I confirmed receipt of the completed affidavit and did an initial validation. A few points and next steps to clear INV-78921: 

1) The document includes your Missouri state reseller ID (12-3456789) and covers MO + AR. That satisfies the state-level requirement.
2) County stamping/notarization: because you stated nexus in St. Louis and Jefferson counties, we need either a county permit number or a notarized affidavit for those specific counties before we can apply the exemption to transactions tied to those counties. Pulaski County (AR) does not require additional stamping based on our checks.
3) Action required: Please provide either
   - notarized copy of the affidavit that names St. Louis and Jefferson counties, OR
   - county permit numbers for St. Louis and Jefferson (if available).

Operational note: I have placed INV-78921 on a temporary hold for the Missouri line items only; once we have the notarized affidavit or the county permit numbers we will release the hold and apply the exemption retroactively to the affected invoices.

You can upload the notarized PDF here: https://redwood.app/secure-upload/MWI-78921 — that will route directly to our finance audit queue.

Attached: invoice_INV-78921.pdf (for your reference).

If youd like, Lauren can advise on typical county-level wording that speeds acceptance.
